 for the petitioner.

The petitioner has approached this Court under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, inter alia,
for issuance of a writ of mandamus directing the respondent-Corporation to consider the registration certificate of the petitioner to run club/canteen under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 duly issued by the Department of Food & Drug Administration, Haryana on 25.04.2014 (Annexure P-1) for allotment of Khokha site at Sector 17-B, Bus Stand, Chandigarh issued vide Tender Notice dated 10.08.2017.
2.

Vide letter dated 16.10.2017 (Annexure P-4), the petitioner was directed to appear before the respondent-authority on 20.10.2017 at 11.00 a.m., to which, vide letter dated 20.10.2017 (Annexure P-5), the petitioner had replied by saying that he was not in a position to attend the office 1 of 2 personally due to illness.
When confronted with this situation, learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that he may be allowed to withdraw the present writ petition being premature at this stage.

However, it shall be open to the petitioner to take recourse to the Sant Lal @ Sant Lal Saran vs Chandigarh Industrial Tourism ... on 2 November, 2017 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/16508911/
1 remedies as may be available to him, in accordance with law.
